rules.github_actions: FORBIDDEN: do not create, enable, dispatch, rerun or use workflows; never create .github/workflows/ or any Actions workaround.
rules.markdown_layout: Root BRAND.md, CATEGORY.md and ALL-INSTRUMENT.md only, plus README.md and AGENTS.md. No new dated findings, progress parts, RESUME/history Markdown or effects/ documents.
rules.research_priority: Eligible multi-effects found on Shopee Indonesia, plus eligible ever-owned units. Re-search brands and series when saved leads are exhausted.
rules.guitar_scope: Multi-effects only; genuine bass/vocal categories retained. Dedicated-purpose pedals and FV01 excluded.
rules.specifications: Manufacturer product pages, original manuals, firmware/software documentation. Sellers establish asking-price evidence, not authoritative technical specifications.
rules.prices: Used/new IDR separately; preserve dates, seller/item, condition, stock, region, bundle, voucher and indexed/direct-access limitations. No guessed FX or percentage-of-new used prices.
rules.commit_policy: Commit each model's useful findings before researching another; update affected views and this ledger. A first-pass profile with unknowns is not fully verified.
rules.merge_policy: Read complete source, preserve every factual qualifier and source URL, verify destination and incoming links before retiring old files. Do not merely rename progress files or change extensions and call it consolidation. No destructive history rewrite.
rules.privacy: No private receipt/message/order identifiers or payment details in public files. Ownership is separate from specifications, current retention and current stock.
